scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:pages: npm run build --prefix frontend && rm -rf assets && cp frontend/dist/index.html ./index.html && cp frontend/dist/index.html ./404.html && cp -R frontend/dist/assets ./assets && cp frontend/dist/favicon.svg ./favicon.svg && cp frontend/dist/icons.svg ./icons.svg && touch .nojekyll
